When the association completes, you can enable the plugin on speciﬁc indexes or conﬁgure it as
needed based on your requirements. To apply third-party plugin functionality to speciﬁc indexes,
modify the index settings during index creation or update existing indexes. For example, if your
third-party plugin includes a custom analyzer, reference it in the index settings.
To apply the plugin features consistently across multiple indexes, use index templates that
include the plugin conﬁgurations. Always consult the plugin documentation to understand how to
conﬁgure its features for your OpenSearch setup.
